_comment: One entry per pin of the Pinterest board 'patterns new'. Text in the pins is ignored on purpose. Fields: pattern = what the mark-making actually is; scope = where it is applied (subject | background | whole); texture = surface qualities; separation = how the subject stays readable against the background; palette = colour logic; derive = what a filter must do to reproduce it; status = used | partial | unused (relative to what is built today); preset = what the right-hand render uses now.

rows.pattern: Pixel mosaic of the flower head only, about 14 cells across, cells are flat translucent colour that overlap like watercolour tiles. Behind it a second copy of the subject, blurred and sepia, acts as a soft drop shadow and is itself coarsely pixelated. Stem is a plain thin line, not pixelated.
rows.texture: Matte paper with fine grain; tiles slightly translucent so overlaps darken.
rows.separation: Background is untouched cream paper. The mosaic exists only where the flower is; the soft sepia shadow copy lifts it off the paper.
rows.palette: Image colours quantised to 4 to 5 pinks; shadow is one sepia tone.
rows.derive: Segment subject; pixelate the subject only; draw an offset blurred sepia copy beneath; leave the background as flat paper. No grid, no bevel, no box behind.
rows.note: Your note: take the centre flower and the shadow style only, no box style in the background. Agreed, that is exactly the scope error on my side.

rows.pattern: 1-bit pixel art: two colours only. Shapes are solid silhouettes. A 50 percent checker dither appears only inside the cloud shading band and as horizontal dashes in the water. Stars are a few hand-placed single pixels.
rows.texture: Crisp hard pixels, no grain, no anti-aliasing.
rows.separation: Flat areas stay perfectly flat: the sky is solid dark with no noise, the cloud is solid light. Only transition bands get dither, so edges read as drawn outlines.
rows.derive: Two-tone quantisation with a dead zone: tones near white become solid paper, tones near black solid ink, only a narrow mid band gets ordered dither. Never dither flat regions.
rows.note: Your note: no dots in the white space. Correct. My Bayer matrix fires everywhere, including flat regions. The fix is a dead zone around the threshold so flats stay solid.

rows.pattern: Three flat colours, navy, olive and tan. Areas are solid fills; gradients are made by small square dots of the lighter colour on the darker one, spaced on a regular grid with density changing row by row. The sun is a solid disc; the water has rows of tan dots. No glyphs of any kind.
rows.texture: Flat squares with regular gaps; a rounded frame around the scene.
rows.separation: Palette does the work: sky is solid navy with sparse square stars, land is khaki and tan, water is olive. Flat regions are solid, transitions use checker density.
rows.palette: Four flat colours: navy, khaki, peach, olive.
rows.derive: Cell mosaic with a 3-colour palette: fills for the levels and square dots for the density dither between them.
rows.note: Your note: we only have this square. Agreed, I mis-read this as ASCII because of the pin title. The technique is a gapped square mosaic with a small palette.

rows.pattern: A blurred flower photo seen through a grid of frosted glass tiles. Each tile shifts and softens the image slightly (refraction), tiles have faint bright edges. Beyond the tiles the subject dissolves into a soft glow. The background is a plain vertical gradient, peach to white, with fine grain.
rows.texture: Frosted glass, soft specular tile edges, fine grain in the gradient.
rows.separation: The subject is confined to the tile grid; the background gradient is clean and the white card is flat. The glow halo around the tiles fades into the background.
rows.palette: Image colours kept, warmed by the peach wash.
rows.derive: Glass-tile refraction grid over the subject (per-tile UV offset plus blur plus edge highlight), bloom halo, flat gradient background with grain. The blur alone is not the technique.
rows.note: Your note: liquid glass background and glass cubes on top over a gradient. Agreed, the tile refraction is the defining element and I only built the blur.

rows.pattern: Same glass-tile grid as pin 3 with a coarser tile size, a larger blur radius and more grain. The pink wash replaces the peach one.
rows.separation: As pin 3: clean gradient background, tiles only over the subject.
rows.palette: Image colours under a pink wash.
rows.derive: Same as pin 3 with tile size, blur radius and grain as sliders.
rows.note: Your note: same as pin 3 but the colour spacing and sprinkles differ. Yes: tile size, blur radius and grain amount are the parameters.

rows.pattern: Cross-stitch chart. A fine grey aida grid covers the whole card. Stitches exist only where the daisy is. Each stitch is two rounded threads crossing, with a highlight along the top thread and a small shadow under it, so every X has volume. Stitch colours are limited to the three chart colours.
rows.texture: Matte 3D thread, visible fabric holes, grid lines everywhere, stitches slightly irregular.
rows.separation: Empty grid where there is no subject; the raised threads cast a shadow onto the fabric, which lifts the subject off the background.
rows.palette: Three chart colours: light blue, yellow, green.
rows.derive: Subject mask; per cell two shaded thread strokes with highlight and drop shadow; palette quantised to 3 to 6 colours; background = plain grid fabric. My flat X marks are too thin and have no volume.
rows.note: Your note: matte, 3D, elegant stitches not identified. Agreed. Volume (highlight plus shadow per thread) and a clean empty grid are what make it read.

rows.pattern: A photographed 3D embossed box with hand-painted pastel gouache florals arranged around it. The surface is embossed paper; the flowers are opaque painted strokes.
rows.texture: Embossed paper relief, gouache strokes, soft studio light.
rows.separation: Painted shapes sit on a plain off-white paper; the box has a real shadow.
rows.palette: Pastel blues, pinks, greens on off-white.
rows.derive: Not an image filter. The reusable part is the embossed paper background texture and opaque gouache stroke fills, which would be a painterly technique, not built.
rows.note: Your note: misunderstood, 3D background surface with pastel hand-drawn paintings on top. Agreed, my riso mapping was wrong; this is embossed paper plus gouache.

rows.pattern: Translucent layered petal shapes with soft gradient fills and grain. Ghost copies of the shapes sit behind in cream. Background is flat cream.
rows.texture: Gradient mesh inside flat shapes, fine grain, frosted overlap where shapes cross.
rows.separation: Flat background, shapes defined by their own soft edges and the ghost outline copies.
rows.derive: Posterise into a few flat shapes, fill each with a soft gradient plus grain, keep translucency where shapes overlap, flat background.

rows.pattern: A geometric cross-stitch repeat (lattice with small diamond motifs) in a single red thread on natural linen. The stitches read flat, like a printed sampler.
rows.texture: Linen weave across the whole background, slight thread texture in the stitches.
rows.separation: One colour against bare linen; the lattice has clean edges and the border rows change rhythm.
rows.derive: Monochrome stitch on a linen texture; the motif is a repeat, so for photos this is single-colour stitching of the subject on linen.

rows.pattern: Dot-matrix globe on black. Inside the circle every grid position has a mark: land is a filled dot in one of three colours, ocean is a small hollow ring. Outside the circle there is nothing.
rows.texture: Flat vector dots, perfectly regular grid, no glow.
rows.separation: Two mark types do the separating: filled dots for the subject, hollow rings for the subject's own background, empty black outside the shape.
rows.derive: Grid marks with two states: filled for dark or coloured tone, hollow ring for light tone; nothing outside the subject mask. Palette of 3.

rows.pattern: Collage of displaced rectangular blocks: a soft colour-blurred field, a block of LED-like pink dots, pixel-sorted strips, UI overlays and scanline bands. Blocks are hard-edged and overlap.
rows.texture: Mixed: blur, dot matrix, scanlines, thin UI lines.
rows.separation: Hard block edges against black.
rows.palette: Pink and violet on black with a warm blurred field.
rows.derive: Block displacement with per-block treatment (blur, dots, pixel sort), chroma split, scanlines.

rows.pattern: A sky photo reduced to two inks, blue and white, with heavy stipple grain, and a thin white grid overlaid with one cell tinted red.
rows.separation: Tone alone; the grid is a graphic overlay.
rows.palette: Blue and white, one red accent.
rows.derive: Two-ink grain stipple (closer to Riso with a noise dither than to halftone), plus an optional grid overlay with one highlighted cell.

rows.pattern: Blue halftone dots on white. Dot size follows tone of soft cloud shapes, on a straight 0 degree grid. Where the source is white there are no dots at all.
rows.texture: Dots have slightly soft edges like spread ink.
rows.separation: Empty white where there is no subject; dots only appear where tone exists.
rows.derive: Single-ink halftone with a hard cut below a tone floor so white space stays empty; soft dot edges.

rows.pattern: UI mock-up.
rows.derive: Eliminated by you.

rows.pattern: Flat vector florals on black. Each shape is a flat colour with airbrushed stipple shading at its edges, giving a paper-cut look with soft spray inside the shapes.
rows.texture: Grainy stipple gradients confined inside each flat shape; black background is flat.
rows.separation: Solid black background; shapes are opaque with stipple only inside.
rows.derive: Posterise into flat shapes, add edge stipple inside each shape, keep the background flat. Shadows between layers are optional here.

rows.pattern: Isometric 3D pixel tiles (black and white checker) float as a dandelion head; some tiles and pills scatter outward. The stem and leaves are pixel-stepped shapes filled with watercolour texture. Background is black with a fabric grain.
rows.texture: Watercolour and pencil inside geometric pixel shapes; extruded tiles with visible side faces.
rows.separation: Nothing on the background; the subject is lit from the top-left so side faces are darker.
rows.derive: Extrude the subject as isometric slabs with darker side faces; paint texture inside; a few loose tiles; flat dark ground.

rows.pattern: Blobby gradient stickers with grain and gloss.
rows.separation: Flat white background.
rows.derive: Shape illustration, not an image technique.

rows.pattern: Second glitch collage: pixelated block, green LED dot cluster, displaced photo strip, scanline bar at the bottom.
rows.separation: Hard block edges on black.
rows.derive: As pin 10.

rows.pattern: Flat pansy illustrations on black with two or three tones per petal and faint paper texture.
rows.separation: Solid black background.
rows.derive: Flat posterised illustration; nothing beyond posterise plus paper grain.

rows.pattern: Retro pixel-art illustration: a limited 4 to 5 colour palette (olive greens and cream), hard pixel outlines drawn first, flat fills, dither only inside the CRT screen glow and the starfield.
rows.texture: Hard pixels, outline-led drawing, dither as texture only in two places.
rows.separation: Outlines and palette steps, not tone.
rows.palette: Dark green, mid green, olive, cream.
rows.derive: Retro palette quantisation with outline extraction and dither limited to gradients. This is a palette and outline technique, not a bitmap dither.
rows.note: Your note: retro style, not bitmap. Agreed.

rows.pattern: Soft translucent isometric cubes forming clouds. Faces are frosted, edges soft, no outlines. Flat blue background with grain.
rows.texture: Frosted translucency, soft shading, fine grain.
rows.separation: Flat blue; cubes are lighter than the sky with a slightly darker underside.
rows.palette: White and pale blue on sky blue.
rows.derive: Voxel extrusion of the subject with translucent faces and a flat background. My faces are opaque and hard; softness is missing.

rows.pattern: Painted figure in a soft landscape, everything blurred, heavy film grain over the whole image, colour fringing at edges.
rows.separation: Value contrast only.
rows.derive: Blur plus grain plus slight chroma offset over the whole image.

rows.pattern: Flat vector illustration with layered paper-cut clouds; each flat shape has grain shading; two dominant inks.
rows.texture: Grain inside flat shapes, crisp shape edges.
rows.separation: Layered shapes, lighter toward the front.
rows.derive: Posterise to a few layers, grain inside each layer, two-ink palette.

rows.pattern: Retro palette scene: five flat colours with black outlines; shadows are drawn as checker dither, not as darker colour. Outline first, then fills.
rows.texture: Hard pixels, checker dither in shadow areas only.
rows.separation: Black outlines around every shape.
rows.derive: Palette quantisation to 5 colours, outline extraction, checker dither for shadow tones only.

rows.pattern: Photo with grain and a glowing white silhouette; type on top.
rows.derive: Text ignored. The glowing silhouette is a subject-mask glow, possibly worth a technique later.

rows.pattern: Type poster, gradient wash background with grain.
rows.derive: Text ignored; nothing else to take.

rows.pattern: Watercolour texture background with photo cut-outs in a frame.
rows.derive: Collage, not a filter.

rows.pattern: Square LED dots in two sizes, orange on brown; dot density thins out away from the centre (dissolve). Dots are missing at random, not sized by tone.
rows.separation: Density gradient only.
rows.derive: Dot presence by probability from tone or distance (dissolve), two dot sizes, no dot scaling.

rows.pattern: White marks only, on a flat lavender ground: full squares, half squares (vertical rectangles) and small dots, chosen by the tone of soft cloud shapes. One colour, straight grid, nothing where the tone is dark.
rows.separation: Empty lavender where the source is dark; squares only in the light subject.
rows.derive: Single-colour cell marks by tone: dot, half square, square; flat ground.

rows.pattern: Isometric extruded pixel lilies: white cubes with darker side faces, green pixel stems with watercolour fill, soft drop shadows; black background with fabric grain.
rows.texture: Extruded tiles, paint texture inside, drop shadows.
rows.separation: Flat dark background, lit from top-left.
rows.derive: As pin 15.

rows.pattern: Geometric flat shapes with gradient fills and grain, translucent overlaps, colour-block background.
rows.texture: Gradient plus grain inside flat shapes.
rows.separation: Shape edges and colour blocks.
rows.derive: Posterised shapes with gradient fills and grain.

rows.pattern: Confetti ring: small circles, triangles and squares in four pastel colours, mint, lilac, pink and orange, scattered around a card; density falls off with distance from the card.
rows.palette: Mint, lilac, pink, orange on cream.
rows.derive: Particle scatter of three shapes in four colours with radial density; not an image filter.

rows.pattern: Extruded pixel tulip: stepped pixel silhouette extruded with side faces, watercolour fill, black background with grain.
rows.texture: Paint texture inside geometric pixels, side faces darker.
rows.separation: Flat black.
rows.derive: As pin 15.

rows.pattern: Rows of tiny typeset text fill the iris; the flower is a mask that reveals the text, and the text takes the flower's colours, blues and greens, with a soft gradient across it. Not stitching. Faint large letters behind are ignored.
rows.texture: Linen canvas grain across the whole sheet, fine thread texture in the subject.
rows.separation: Bare canvas outside the mask; inside, the text rows carry the image colour.
rows.derive: Subject mask reveals a typeset-row texture tinted with the image colour; canvas background.

rows.pattern: Landscape shapes filled with fine concentric line hatching (like guilloche or wood grain) in purple-to-green gradients; the sky is plain; the bird is a flat gradient.
rows.texture: Fine parallel and concentric lines inside shapes, moire-like.
rows.separation: Plain sky; each shape has its own line direction.
rows.derive: Per-shape concentric line fill following the shape outline (a distance-field engraving). Not built; distinct from my stroke engraving.

rows.pattern: A photo of a flower field cut by a pixel-stepped flower silhouette. Inside the mask the photo is untouched, with its own colours; outside is flat white.
rows.separation: Hard blocky mask edge.
rows.derive: Blocky silhouette cut-out: photo kept inside, paper outside. Colours must not change.

rows.pattern: The plant is built from pixel-stepped silhouettes extruded as slabs in an isometric view: leaves are flat planes at different depths, stems are tall thin slabs, the pot is a block. Faces have watercolour fills; side faces are darker.
rows.separation: Flat black.
rows.derive: Extrude the subject silhouette as layered slabs in perspective (lightness picks the plane), paint texture on the faces, flat dark ground. Not a bevelled pixel grid.

rows.pattern: Brand board whose textures are dot-halftone gradients that dissolve into the background.
rows.derive: Eliminated by you.

rows.pattern: Rounded-corner blocks (squircles) of three sizes cluster into the canopy, each with a vertical gradient from dark green at the top to yellow-green at the bottom. Grey blocks form the trunk. Thin outline-only echoes of the blocks float in the background. There are no shadows.
rows.texture: Smooth gradients, rounded block shapes, outline echoes.
rows.separation: Light grey gradient background; outline echoes repeat the block shape without colour.
rows.derive: Rounded blocks over the subject with a per-block vertical gradient, outline echoes in the background, no cast shadows.

rows.pattern: Small five-petal flower glyphs on a grid, in rust, orange, blue and brown, form a cloud; sparse dots continue the grid where the cloud thins. Paper background with grain. On hover the pointer paints flowers that fade back to dots.
rows.separation: Empty paper where there is no subject.
rows.derive: Glyph field: flower where dark, dot where light; trail cursor mode paints flowers that fade.

rows.pattern: A soft pink bloom shape, heavily blurred, with grain inside the gradient; the background fades white to pink.
rows.texture: Grain in gradients, no hard edges.
rows.separation: Tone only.
rows.derive: Blur plus grain plus a wash; this one the current Airbrush already covers.

rows.pattern: Cross-stitch chart on blue grid paper: stitches drawn as solid squares in three greens and brown, X texture faint, grid lines visible through the empty areas.
rows.texture: Chart paper with grid, flat stitch squares.
rows.separation: Empty grid paper around the subject; a black frame.
rows.derive: Chart-style stitch: square cells with a faint X, on grid paper, subject-only, palette of 4 to 5.

rows.pattern: A photo of a runner where a grid of small uniform cyan dots covers the figure only. The background photo is untouched. A few dots scatter just outside the silhouette.
rows.texture: Uniform dots, no size change; soft photo beneath.
rows.separation: The dot field follows the subject mask; the sky keeps its photo texture.
rows.derive: Uniform dots inside the subject mask, photo kept underneath, nothing outside.

rows.pattern: 1-bit line art: white pixel outlines on black, hardly any fills, retro text-adventure style. This is edge drawing, not tone dithering.
rows.separation: Outlines only.
rows.derive: Edge detection quantised to 1-pixel lines, two colours, no dither.

rows.pattern: Round dots on a grid forming two birds; three colours; black background with nothing outside the subject.
rows.separation: Empty black outside the shapes.
rows.derive: Round-dot grid mosaic, palette of 3, subject-only. Same family as pins 9 and 53.

rows.pattern: Blue floral cross-stitch on white aida. The aida grid texture is visible across the whole fabric; stitches only in the flowers; three blues.
rows.texture: Aida weave everywhere, stitched X marks with slight volume.
rows.separation: Bare fabric where there is no flower.
rows.derive: Stitch with subject mask, palette of 3, fabric texture background.

rows.pattern: Stipple dither engraving of flowers: black dots whose density follows tone, with crisp solid lines for stems. White space has no dots at all.
rows.texture: Dot stipple on a grid, solid line work.
rows.separation: Clean white where there is no subject; dark areas go solid.
rows.derive: Density stipple (error-diffusion style) with a tone floor so white stays empty.

rows.pattern: A chair drawn only with short dashed blue strokes. Strokes follow the surface direction of each part: diagonal on the seat, vertical on the legs. There is no tonal fill; the object is described by stroke flow alone. Background is a flat pale green.
rows.texture: Uniform dash length and spacing, single ink.
rows.separation: Flat background; the object exists only as dash flow.
rows.derive: Straight dashes on the subject only, one direction per surface, fixed dash length and spacing with a brick offset, single ink, no tonal fill.

rows.pattern: Soft star shapes with grainy gradient fills on a light blue background with wavy translucent shapes.
rows.separation: Light flat background.
rows.derive: Shape illustration.

rows.pattern: A real flower photo whose upper left turns into flat pixel squares, with a visible transition from photo to pixels. The vase is a dotted halftone gradient glass. Cream background.
rows.separation: Flat cream background.
rows.derive: Partial pixelation of the subject with a spatial transition; a dot-halftone treatment on a second region. Not built.

rows.pattern: Blurred landscape with heavy grain and colour fringing, like a degraded film still.
rows.separation: Tone only.
rows.derive: As pin 21.

rows.pattern: 1-bit tree: cream pixels on navy. The foliage is solid with a dither band at its edge; water is horizontal dashed lines; stars are sparse single pixels; the sky is solid.
rows.texture: Hard pixels, line raster for water.
rows.separation: Solid flats, dither only at tone transitions.
rows.derive: As pin 1, plus a line-raster mode for one region.

rows.pattern: Soft fruit icons with grainy gradient fills.
rows.derive: Icon illustration.

rows.pattern: Round dot grid globe on black. Land is filled dots in three colours; ocean is hollow ring dots; nothing outside the circle.
rows.separation: Filled versus hollow marks inside the subject, empty outside.
rows.derive: As pin 9.

rows.pattern: Blurred translucent flower shapes with grain on a flat lilac background.
rows.separation: Tone only.
rows.derive: Blur plus grain plus wash; covered by Airbrush.

rows.pattern: 1-bit scene, single green ink on pale paper. Trees are dense dither clusters, the house and car are solid fills with one-pixel outlines, shadows are 50% checker.
rows.separation: Flats stay solid; only foliage and shadows dither. Sky is bare paper.
rows.derive: Bitmap technique with one ink, band dither on foliage only. Already close with Handheld; needs a checker shadow mode.

rows.pattern: Grid of large squares, each filled with one of four fill levels: solid, fine dot screen, coarse dot screen, empty. The squares form a loose diagonal cluster, not an image.
rows.texture: Flat vector, halftone screens inside squares.
rows.separation: Decorative corner element on white. Nothing to separate.
rows.derive: Cells technique with 4 levels and marks none, dotscreen, dotscreen-coarse, fill, cell size large. Halftone Press is the nearest today.

rows.pattern: Hand-drawn pixel line art of a room: one-pixel blue outlines, dashed lines for perspective, dither patches for shadows on the chair and door.
rows.separation: Only outlines and sparse dither; large flats are bare grey.
rows.derive: Edge detect to one-pixel lines, dash the long straight edges, fill mid tones with sparse dither. New: line-art mode.

rows.pattern: Real ceramic mosaic: 1cm tiles, the dog is 2 to 3 tones of iridescent grey-green, background tiles are white with slight tint variation. Grout lines visible.
rows.texture: Glossy ceramic, slight tilt per tile, grout gaps.
rows.separation: Subject tiles are coloured, background tiles white, same grid continues across.
rows.palette: Grey-green and oil-slick tints on white.
rows.derive: Paper Mosaic at tile size 1 with gap and a white background tile. Adds a gloss highlight per tile.

rows.pattern: Figure made of three marks on a blue cross-hatched ground: white grid lines, black solid, red solid blocks. The ground itself is a dense pattern of small x crosses.
rows.separation: Subject marks sit on a patterned ground, so separation is by mark type, not by blankness.
rows.derive: Cells with a patterned ground mark (x) and three subject marks (grid, fill black, fill red) picked by tone and saturation.

rows.pattern: Three-tone landscape: dark navy, olive, orange. Sky dithers from orange to navy with a dot gradient; the tree is solid; the sun is a solid disc.
rows.separation: Solid flats, dither only in the sky gradient.
rows.derive: Bitmap with three palette levels, ordered dither only in gradients. Bitmap Night with a mid colour.

rows.pattern: Mountain built from vertical dashes, dash density gives tone. White on green with the inverse at the top. The dashes are all vertical, no curves.
rows.separation: Tone to dash density; the ridge line is where density flips.
rows.derive: Hatch technique locked to 90 degrees with dash mode and density from tone. Needs a fixed-angle option.

rows.pattern: Dot halftone corner element: round dots on a fixed grid, dot size steps through 3 or 4 sizes in blocks, forming a cluster of squares.
rows.separation: Decorative, on black.
rows.derive: Cells with a dot mark whose size is quantised per block, not per pixel. Dot Matrix with block-level quantisation.

rows.pattern: Grid collage: photo, dot plot, and a soft gradient blob each occupy a cell, with monospace corner labels. Not a pattern over an image, a layout.
rows.separation: Hard cell borders.
rows.palette: Photo colours, pink dots, blue to orange gradient.
rows.derive: Out of scope as a technique; could become a layout export later.

rows.pattern: Same as pin 59 on a phone: x-cross ground in blue, figure in white rings, plus signs, and solid red and black.
rows.separation: By mark type.
rows.derive: Same recipe as pin 59.

rows.pattern: Cloud in 1-bit on flat blue and magenta bands. The cloud top is solid pink with dither edges, the lower cloud breaks into checker and blocks as it fades.
rows.separation: Flat bands stay solid; only the cloud dithers.
rows.derive: Bitmap on the cloud only, with a dissolve-to-checker at the bottom edge. Bitmap Water is close.

rows.pattern: Illustration of stacked 3D slabs in perspective with tiny figures. Reference for the voxel slab technique: slab faces are flat tints, no outlines, soft grain.
rows.separation: Slabs cast no shadows; depth is by face tint.
rows.palette: Peach, blue, yellow, red on cream.
rows.derive: Use as the look target for Voxel slab mode: flat tinted faces with grain, no outlines.

rows.pattern: Isometric boxes with outlines, one lilac tint with dark purple sides, small loose boxes orbiting the main cluster.
rows.separation: White background.
rows.derive: Look target for Voxel slab mode with outlines on. Same family as pin 36.

rows.pattern: A numeral built from large black rectangles with gaps, on a dusty blue card. Pure type, no image.
rows.separation: None.
rows.derive: Could be a blocky-type mode for Type Reveal. Low priority.

rows.pattern: A cube made of stipple dots on blue: dot density gives the faces, edges are denser.
rows.separation: Blue flat background, dots only on the cube.
rows.derive: Dot Veil with random stipple instead of ordered dots.

rows.pattern: Monochrome photo of a bridge, ordered-dithered: Bayer pattern in the sky, solid black in the shadows.
rows.separation: None, whole image.
rows.derive: Bitmap with full ordered dither, no band limit. Newsprint already does this.

rows.pattern: Two bottles and an apple in two inks: blue and red. Each object is one-pixel outline plus diagonal line raster for shading, solid for darkest.
rows.separation: White background untouched.
rows.derive: Riso duotone with a diagonal line raster shading mode instead of dots.

rows.pattern: Same series as pin 68, numeral 2.
rows.separation: None.
rows.derive: As pin 68.

rows.pattern: Strawberry made of small round dots on a grid, dot presence by tone, two colours: red body, yellow-green leaves. Highlights are gaps.
rows.separation: White background bare.
rows.derive: Dot Matrix with subject only and hue kept. Already achieved.

rows.pattern: Two-colour pixel scene, violet on pink: sky dithers in a dot gradient, train is outline plus checker.
rows.separation: Flats solid, dither in sky gradient.
rows.derive: Handheld with ink and paper set to violet and pink.

rows.pattern: Five-colour pixel street scene: cream, black, peach, red, blue. Sky and road use dot screens, buildings are flats with outlines.
rows.texture: Hard pixels, dot screens in flats.
rows.separation: By palette.
rows.palette: Five flat colours, shown as swatches.
rows.derive: Riso Street with a 5 colour palette quantise and dot screen in large flats.

rows.pattern: Portrait in 1-bit ordered dither inside a rounded frame. Classic bitmap effect.
rows.separation: Frame crops it.
rows.derive: Newsprint. Already achieved.

rows.pattern: Clouds on blue: the sky is a fine dot screen, clouds are solid white with dither edges.
rows.separation: Solid where bright, screen where blue.
rows.derive: Bitmap Water with a dot screen in the sky band.
